title: ham hai moula ke diwaane
body:
ham hai moula ke diwane dunya kya jaane
ham hai aaqa ke deewane dunya kya jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
ye dunya kya jaane hame kya pehchane
ham hai panjetan ke diwane dunya kya jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
hame kya milta hai sarwar kisiko kya pata huzoor
jis ke dil me bughze ali ho wo ye kya jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
ali walo abhi jao hath me jaam uthaao
khule hai aaj yaha maiqaane dunya kya jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
naaraye hyderi kaho aaj sab mil ke mohibbo
ye naara lagta kitna pyara dunya kya jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
lahad tak aye mere moula na choote daman tumhara
yahi hai baqshish ka sahara dunya kya jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
lahad me noor apka ruq e purnoor apka
yahi hai jannat ka nazaara dunya kya jaane
<<DIVIDER>>
kaat'te hai sabhi chakkar gird kaabe ko jo jakar
kis ki hai ye wiladat ki jaa dunya kya jaane
